name: michaelcarloh/option-pricing
description: This repository contains various models and techniques for pricing financial options. The focus is on implementing the Black-Scholes model and some of its extensions (e.g. Heston) , visualizing implied volatility surfaces, and utilizing Monte Carlo simulations for exotic option pricing. PYPI pckg: https://pypi.org/project/tiny-pricing-utils/1.0.3/
score_rationale: Useful notebook-style implementation covering pricing models, exotic options, and implied volatility surfaces, though it is more educational than production-grade.
